design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., a muted blue or teal) for pull-quote borders and table header backgrounds.
Set all body text in a serif font (e.g., Georgia or Chronicle); use a sans-serif for table headers and sidebar labels only if needed for contrast.
Apply a hairline rule above and below each table to separate it from prose; no vertical rules inside tables.
Place the pull-quote in a box with a left-side rule (thick accent colour) and italic text, positioned after the paragraph that introduces the concentration risk.
The sidebar should be a narrow column (about 30% width) aligned to the right of the offer section, with a light background tint and a thin border.
